howto.name: Upload your PDF
howto.text: Drop a PDF up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Choose a stamp
howto.text: Preset: APPROVED, CONFIDENTIAL, COPY, DRAFT, FINAL, NOT APPROVED, SAMPLE, VOID. Or custom: your own text.

howto.name: Set opacity and position
howto.text: Opacity runs from 5 to 100 % (30 % by default) and fades the stamp's colour; the letters stay solid. Position: centre, top or bottom (Diagonal currently places it level across the centre as well). Pages: all, or page numbers and ranges separated by commas, such as 1,3,5-8. Click Apply.

faq.q: Are stamps editable annotations or baked-in?
faq.a: Baked into the page content. They survive copying, printing, and PDF/A conversion. To remove, use Whiteout to cover them.

faq.q: Can I apply a stamp to only specific pages?
faq.a: Yes. Enter page numbers and ranges separated by commas, such as 1,3,5-8, or leave it as all; an open range like 8- runs to the last page. A page the PDF does not have is refused with a message giving its page range, and nothing is stamped.
It is sized automatically from the page width and the length of the text, up to 72 pt: on an A4 page CONFIDENTIAL spans most of the width and VOID about a third of it. The size cannot be set by hand.
